parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp for querying the creation time of scaling activities. The unit is milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeTypes
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- ONDEMAND: Pay-as-you-go instance.

- SPOT: Spot instance.The default value is null, which means all billing methods are selected.Example: \["ONDEMAND", "SPOT"]

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in a single request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the position from which the query starts.

parameters.name: ScalingActivityStates
parameters.description: The status of the scaling activity. The number of elements in the array can range from 1 to 20.

parameters.name: ScalingActivityType
parameters.description:
The type of the scaling activity. Valid values:

- SCALE\_OUT: Scale-out.

- SCALE\_IN: Scale-in.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleName
parameters.description: The name of the scaling rule.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp for querying the creation time of scaling activities. The unit is milliseconds.
